Body.Content:
Customers can identify blocked ports faster with the Azure Portal's latest enhancement.

The VM Overview blade in the Azure Portal has a new troubleshooter tool allowing users to run network diagnostics and check for common ports being blocked. This greatly reduces the effort needed to catch some of the most common network issues.
Learn more.
